description.value: Local Pizza is a Vancouver Island-born pizza chain emphasizing local ownership and fresh ingredients, with five locations across the Victoria area. The Shelbourne location serves the eastern Victoria neighbourhood with customizable and pre-set pizzas available for pickup or delivery. Founded on Vancouver Island and operated by local employees, it positions itself as a neighbourhood pizzeria rather than a national franchise.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (6 spaces, covered) at 14m; bollard (2 spaces) at 73m; stands (8 spaces) at 86m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Local Pizza is a multi-location pizza chain; the Shelbourne location (3949 Shelbourne St) matches OSM postcode V8P 4J2 and the lat/lon coordinates in Victoria's Shelbourne neighbourhood, allowing a confident address match. The website explicitly lists PICKUP and online ordering at all locations, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field contains only postcode (V8P 4J2); street address 3949 Shelbourne St inferred from website's Shelbourne location listing matching that postcode — not independently verified.

Multi-location chain; the single OSM record and website URL cover all locations — this record is for the Shelbourne location specifically.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pizza restaurant in Victoria with confirmed pickup service and active website. A practical food stop for touring cyclists.
